classificationMethod.directDependencies: Every declaration in every pnpm importer is classified by manifest section plus an explicit extension build/test tool pattern. Shipped-runtime means a direct product dependency, not proof that every transitive byte is bundled.
classificationMethod.resolvedSecurityAdjacency: Every registry lock entry whose package name matches a reviewed crypto, serialization, networking, or archive adjacency rule is included; production-closure is pnpm closure metadata, not reachability proof.
classificationMethod.advisoryReachability: Each pnpm audit path is joined to its direct declaration by exact resolved package version. Exact accepted exception paths use their reviewed reachability; other paths inherit shipped runtime, extension build, test, or development-tooling context.
